props.name: loading
props.description: Swaps the label for a spinner and blocks interaction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction. On a native button this is the `disabled` attribute; on anything else — a link — there is no such attribute, so the element is marked `aria-disabled`, taken out of the tab order and made inert to the pointer instead.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, and any glyph beside it.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as another element — usually a router link: `as={Link} to="/start"`. Navigation belongs on a link, and a button nested inside one is invalid interactive markup, so this is how a call to action reaches another page.
